motion_specs.frequency: Restraint over frequency. Do not over-animate; rely on smooth reveals and state changes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .jsx or .js file extensions exclusively for React components; do NOT use .tsx.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main App or layout file.
Use framer-motion for animations. Import components from 'framer-motion' and use them with 'motion.div', etc.
For the Sona video loop in the hero, use an HTML5 <video> tag with autoPlay loop muted playsInline.
Strictly follow the brand color palette. Map these to tailwind config colors in tailwind.config.js.
Implement the email waitlist form saving to a basic backend or mocked logic and trigger a Sonner toast upon success.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (16-24px blur as per brand guidelines).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
